author: FitServers22808
text: Critical "PHP2Shell" RCE flaws (CVE-2026-109618/19) actively exploited. Update PHP immediately (v8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, 8.2.35).

author: DailyDarkWeb
text: UPDATE: LiteLLM traces supply-chain attack to an unrevoked agent-platform key. Its latest investigation replaces the earlier suspicion that GitHub tokens were stolen from internal gateway logs. A master key exposed in May remained valid.

author: tinycrowspvtltd
text: OpenCode flaw lets a malicious MCP server run code on Windows and WSL during sign-in. Rated 9.8/10, no CVE. Fixed in 1.18.33. Affected: 1.0.137 to 1.18.32.

author: BytesNora
text: SecBoard Daily 23 October 2026. Top story: Atlassian Patches 75 Flaws in Data Center and Server Products (CVE-2026-65637, actively exploited).

author: arnaudmercier
text: Headline-grabbing security hole in global websites, found by AI, now has evildoers using AI to exploit the gap.

author: clhdev
text: Arista patched CVE-2026-114625 (CVSS 9.9) in on-prem VeloCloud Orchestrator, an actively exploited SQL injection. Any logged-in user can get superuser operator access. Fixed: 5.2.3.18, 6.1.3.10, 6.4.2.12.

author: thecircuitry_
text: CISA lists CVE-2026-110447 (Collabora Online) as actively exploited. Mitigation deadline is October 26.

author: BytesNora
text: CVE-2026-110936 in Siemens Software Center: confirmed exploitation (CISA KEV) despite CVSS 6.7; DLL hijacking vulnerability actively exploited.

author: XavierRiveraX
text: AWS fixed a validator gap in the run_script tool of its managed AWS MCP Server (CVE-2026-115845). A crafted Python script could run arbitrary code inside the user's own isolated session. Fixed service-side.

author: infinitelogins
text: Johann Rehberger shows how one trailing dot bypassed Copilot's protected-file checks in Visual Studio and SSMS (CVE-2026-103572). Copilot could rewrite its own config and point an MCP server.

author: dhanyqaz
text: CVE-2026-109618/109619 (PHP2Shell): found by the Wiz Atlas agent running Gemini 4 Argon + GPT-5.6 Sol. CVSS 9.2, unauthenticated, ~1.3-1.9M internet-exposed hosts.

author: DarkWebInformer
text: Railway says breach potentially exposed secrets in around 100,000 workspaces: attacker gained access to internal systems and potentially exposed encrypted environment variables for up to 1.85% of workspaces.

author: PocketRetroid
text: jscrambler npm package supply chain attack. Malicious versions 8.14.0-8.20.0 contained infostealer. Stolen credentials used to publish. Update to 8.22.0.

author: FpeSre
text: GhostAction is now trading GitHub Actions OIDC tokens for AWS roles across roughly 12,000 repositories via a fake font file that installs a cron job.

author: Zaardaar
text: Microsoft attributed a ConnectWise Cloud Backup supply-chain attack targeting Microsoft 365 tenants to the China-aligned group Storm-0940, which used AI agents for automation.

author: HighJetCyberLLC
text: npm supply-chain attack: attackers abused trusted publishing to ship the previously unknown GHAPPIER loader through a legitimate package.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: PHP disclosed CVE-2026-115560, an RCE flaw requiring an unusual session-handler configuration. No patch is available; the PHP team recommends disabling session upload progress until a fix is released.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) achieves unauthenticated RCE and memory disclosure across every PHP version since 5.4, with mass exploitation confirmed in the wild before patches shipped. 54.9 million web properties are in scope.

author: FalconFeedsio
text: Ransomware alert: Commonwealth Community Bank, a USA-based bank, has reportedly fallen victim to Qilin ransomware.

author: chronoloq
text: An AI agent built a full Chrome exploit chain in 6 days. XBOW says 3 bugs (V8, WebP, Crashpad) escaped the sandbox from a page load. Google paid $250K; compute was ~$40K (XBOW's figures). Fix: relaunch Chrome, update to 152.0.7977.82+.

author: shyamalankannan
text: The Brotli RCE OpenAI's Codex Security found was already fixed in the source in February. Nobody cut a release, so Node, Bun and Envoy kept bundling the old decoder. AI found the bug, a CVE is what got it shipped. CVE-2026-111497

author: MrClicker_1
text: METR and Redwood got deep access to OpenAI's agent monitoring and found an exploit that could hide hundreds of actions. Patched, says OpenAI; the auditors haven't verified that.

author: cyvocate
text: After PHP2Shell, an earlier October NGINX patch is getting overlooked: CVE-2026-97205 CVSS v4.0: 9.2 (Critical).

author: rst_cloud
text: PHP2Shell: What defenders need to know about CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619. Actors/Campaigns: Stone_panda. Threats: Mirai, LOLBin techniques. Victims: PHP servers, web apps.

author: cyprtochardey
text: Security researchers uncovered Phantom, an AI-driven intrusion framework used by Russian-speaking affiliates of INC and The Gentlemen ransomware groups. The operation relies on an AI-executed, human-approved structure to run cyber intrusions at scale.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-111943 and CVE-2026-111944: Eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificates carry fatally weak P-384 keys, enabling private-key recovery and fraudulent cert issuance. Chrome, Mozilla, Apple, and Microsoft have blocked them; your environment may still trust them.

author: so_sthbryan
text: Attackers hit PHP2Shell four days before the fix. Amazon Threat Intelligence detected exploitation on October 17: CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 are max-severity RCE; zero-day window was just four days.

author: ThreatactixLab
text: Threat advisory: we've tracked 4 active PHP2Shell C2 servers over the last 48 hours, tied to CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, targeting internet-facing PHP apps for unauthenticated RCE.

author: Miss1936
text: Bitcoin Core just rewrote its long-standing security playbook because LLMs are finding bugs way too fast. A policy change merged on Thursday creates a brand-new vulnerability category for flaws discoverable with minimal effort, like running a simple LLM prompt.

author: Knaitobureza
text: Good Smile Company confirmed unauthorized access to their online store administration system between Oct 19 and Oct 22, 2026, due to a vulnerability exploit. Security circles are pointing toward the recent zero-day PHP RCE flaws.

author: vikasmalpani
text: Finding a critical bug used to take skilled humans months. This week researchers at Wiz and OpenAI found two PHP flaws using AI, and Trail of Bits built a working exploit in a day with Codex. If discovery and exploitation compress to a day, what does your patch window become?

author: Horry6c21
text: AI Daily Oct 24, 2026: Kimi K3.1 Pro tops open-model cyber index at 64%, weights by Nov 4. OpenAI bans internet access during frontier model training after agent DNS exploit.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: APT41-linked BlackX UEFI bootkit, an evolved BlackLotus, exploits a 2022 Secure Boot flaw (CVE-2022-21894) still viable on patched systems that skipped manual revocation steps.

author: russano
text: OpenAI's red-team agents forced fixes in Kata, gVisor and Docker plus three kernel CVEs, and two of them talked across separate microVMs through CPU cache timing.

author: Joshua_WD
text: The Node2Shell flaw (CVE-2026-111497) lives in Google's Brotli library, not just Node. Python's Brotli packages, Envoy and C/C++ builds need patches too.

author: dailycve
text: Wasmtime: bit-packing in Cranelift compiler causes silent overflow and miscompilation, CVE-2026-115889 (Critical).

author: raqi_ai_uae
text: OpenAI's red team found an unauthenticated RCE in Brotli (Node.js, Bun, Envoy). CVE-2026-111497, CVSS 9.2. Patch: Node.js 22.23.4 / 24.22.1 / 26.12.1, Brotli 1.2.1 / 1.1.1 / 1.0.10.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: CVE-2026-110936 in Siemens Software Center added to CISA KEV. Uncontrolled search path flaw enables DLL hijacking and arbitrary code execution. Patch by Nov 3, 2026.

author: botnewsnetwork
text: OpenAI has named the first concrete vulnerability its red-team agents found in open-source software: an unauthenticated remote-code-execution flaw in Brotli. The bug sat in the source since February.

author: fpsoftarch
text: The Node/Python Brotli RCE is in the Go port too. CVE-2026-111497, patched today: andybalholm/brotli v1.2.7, pulled in by fasthttp, Fiber, Caddy, Traefik.
